quarterly_data.signal: Amkor's 10-K states that direct sales to Apple and Qualcomm accounted for 29.8% and 11.1% of net sales for the year ended December 31, 2025, and that its ten largest customers accounted for 72% of 2025 net sales. The segment note adds that the largest customer accounted for 30.8% of net sales in 2024 and 27.7% in 2023, and a second customer for 10.2% in 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: Apple 29.8%, Qualcomm 11.1% of 2025 net sales; ten largest customers 72%

quarterly_data.signal: Amkor's 10-K revenue by product line for fiscal year 2025 (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31): Advanced Products $5.56B (+7.4% YoY vs $5.17B) and Mainstream Products $1.15B (+0.8% YoY vs $1.14B). Its end-market distribution table puts Computing (data center, infrastructure, PC/laptop, storage) at 20% of 2025 net sales, versus 19% in 2024 and 16% in 2023.
quarterly_data.figure: Advanced Products $5.56B (+7.4% YoY); Mainstream Products $1.15B (+0.8% YoY); Computing 20% of 2025 net sales (19% 2024, 16% 2023)
